title: Signature study: SHA-2 alongside scrypt
description: 2001 — SHA-2: SHA-2 is a family of hash functions with 224, 256, 384, and 512-bit digests, published by the NSA in 2001 as FIPS-180. alongside scrypt (2009), This Signature pairing study examines the two together as complementary tools in real systems. scrypt is a memory-hard password-based key derivation function designed by Colin Percival and presented in 2009. Filed as JAH-CRY-000019 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
